# Spinner

A 2px round-capped arc on a 1.6s loop. It turns two full circles per cycle while the arc grows from 6% to 74% of the circle and shrinks again. Colour comes from the surrounding text.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/spinner)

## Usage

```tsx
<Spinner />
<Spinner size={18} style={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }} />
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `size` | `number` | Width and height in pixels. 20 in the pay button, 18 in the apply button. |
| `active` | `boolean` | False holds it still. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `Spinner.module.css`
- `Spinner.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
